name: vigil
title: Vigil
description: A funeral director's theme drawn as the night bell by the undertaker's door: green-black door paint, large serif text, and beside every page a moulded panel with a white enamel NIGHT BELL plate, one push in a lit orange ring and the telephone number in big figures.

tokens.--font-plate: the flared signwriting capitals: name, menu, labels, block headings, the plate, people's names
tokens.--font-serif: all reading text, and the telephone number on the bell
tokens.--text-base: size of ordinary text — large, as the serif is meant to be read
tokens.--text-small: size of the smaller text: credentials, people's contact lines, pagination and the footer
tokens.--track: letter spacing of the signwritten capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the page background: green-black door paint, or frosted glass in the light scheme
tokens.--color-text: text on the page background, the menu underline under the current page, the marks beside a service's points, and the focus ring
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text: intros, service descriptions, labels, block headings and their rule, credentials, dates, footer; link underlines
tokens.--color-accent: the lit orange ring around the small push beside the masthead number, on the page background
tokens.--color-ring: the lit orange ring around the bell push on the door-paint panel — the same in both schemes
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules between rows, the double lines under the name and above the footer, the underline of service titles
tokens.--color-shade: background behind code in page text
tokens.--color-door: the moulded panel carrying the bell, hours and address — door paint in both schemes
tokens.--color-door-ink: text on the bell panel, and the focus ring there
tokens.--color-door-muted: labels on the bell panel and the underlines of its links
tokens.--color-door-rule: the thin rules between the parts of the bell panel
tokens.--color-moulding-hi: the light edge of the panel's moulding
tokens.--color-moulding-lo: the shadowed edge of the moulding, the rims of the lit ring and rosette, the shadow under the plate
tokens.--color-enamel: the white enamel of the NIGHT BELL plate
tokens.--color-enamel-ink: the lettering, the lined border and the screw slots of the plate
tokens.--color-bezel: the nickel rosette round the bell push, and the heads of the plate's screws
tokens.--color-push: the face of the bell push, and of the small one beside the number in the masthead
tokens.--color-sheen: the highlight on the domed face of the push
tokens.--color-lamp: the bright inner edge of the lit ring, next to the push
tokens.--color-glow: the orange light the rings throw onto the rosette and the door
tokens.--measure: width of a column of page text
tokens.--jamb: width of the bell panel beside the page on a wide screen
tokens.--push-size: diameter of the bell push with its lit ring, without the rosette
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the panel, code and portraits
tokens.--gutter: space kept at each side of the page on a phone
tokens.--space-1: smallest gap: under a label, between a title and its note
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside rows, under block headings
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and between the parts of the bell panel
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks and above the page
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: between the page and the bell panel, and under the page
